Type:        DENORMALIZER
Name:        Denormalizer
Category:    transformers
Description: Denormalizes input records - ie composes one output record from several input records using user-specified transformation. One group is defined with the same value on the given field(s) or has the fixed size. The transformation is supposed to implement interface RecordDenormalize.
Sends all resulting records to all connected output ports.
Usage:       When to use: Collapse N consecutive input records into exactly 1 output record per group. Simpler than ROLLUP for the pure N→1 case.
             Constraints: Input MUST be sorted on key. Exactly one output record per group (unlike ROLLUP which can emit multiple). Use ROLLUP if you need to emit multiple output records per group or need more complex state.

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [0] (required)

Properties:
  Conditional required groups:
    denormalize | denormalizeClass | denormalizeURL (at least one is required; mutually exclusive)

  key: [key]  Defines the key fields used for key.
  groupSize: [int]  Numeric value that controls group size.
  denormalize [attr-cdata]: [transformDenormalize]  Configures denormalize.
  denormalizeURL: [file]  Specifies the path or URL for denormalize url.
  denormalizeClass: [class]  Configures denormalize class.
  order: [enum]  (default: Auto)  Specifies the sort order to use for processing.
    values: Asc, Desc, Auto, Ignore
  equalNULL: [bool]  (default: true)  Controls whether NULL values are considered equal when identifying duplicates.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  incompleteGroupAllowed: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, controls allow incomplete last group of the component.
  errorActions [attr-cdata]: [errorActions]  Defines the actions to take when errors occur during processing.
  errorLog: [file]  Specifies the file where error information should be logged.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("DENORMALIZER") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
